# LearnScroll

> LearnScroll (App Store name "LearnScroll: Study Shorts") is an iPhone app that turns a PDF, lecture slides, a Word doc, a photo of notes or a typed topic into a feed of short TikTok-style study videos. Quick quizzes appear every 10 videos and spaced repetition brings older videos back. Videos are in English or Turkish. Pro subscription: $4.99/month or $29.99/year (3-day free trial on yearly). No ads.

Key facts:
- Platform: iOS 16.4 or later (iPhone; runs on iPad). No Android app yet (waitlist on the website).
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/learnscroll-study-shorts/id6774384463 (app id 6774384463)
- Inputs: PDF, PowerPoint (.pptx), Word (.docx), plain text, photos of printed or handwritten notes, or a typed topic.
- Output: a vertical swipe feed of short captioned videos, one key idea each, made from the user's own material; ready in about 1 to 3 minutes.
- Learning features: multiple-choice quiz every 10 videos (at most once every 2 minutes), SM-2 style spaced repetition, up to 150 key ideas per upload in deep mode, 12 uploads per month on Pro.
- Who it is for: students who doomscroll instead of studying, exam crammers, people who struggle to read textbooks but can scroll for hours, adults who want a feed that teaches.
- Not to be confused with "Scrollie" (an Android language app whose package name contains "learnscroll").
- Developer: Can Dizdar (independent). Launched July 2026.
